name: BAIS2 - Burned Area Index for Sentinel-2
description: Detects and maps burned areas using Sentinel-2 red-edge spectral bands. BAIS2 leverages the sensitivity of the red-edge region to chlorophyll content for discriminating burn severity at 20m resolution. Index values range from -1 to 1 for burn scars and 1 to 6 for active fires.
